🔥 SnapBack-Rebootless | C#
🎯 Primary Use Case: To manage and reset a Windows session to a clean, predefined state by closing unwanted applications without rebooting, thereby freeing up system resources and reducing clutter.
✨ Key Features: • Records application states as baselines or named profiles. • Monitors session drift from the baseline.
📖 Summary: SnapBack is a Windows application designed to restore your system to a desired baseline state without requiring a reboot. It intelligently identifies and closes applications that have been opened since the baseline was set, allowing them to save work politely, and optionally includes a deep memory cleanup feature.
